name: Wockhardt Ltd.
about: Wockhardt Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a pharmaceutical and biotech company, in India, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It manufactures and trades pharmaceuticals, medicinal chemical, and botanical products, as well as chemicals and chemical products. The company also develops its flagship antibiotic, ZAYNICH zidebactam/cefepime, a novel beta lactam enhancer mechanism for the treatment of sepsis and hospital/ventilator associated pneumonia; FOVISCU, an antibiotic for gram-negative infections; MIQNAF nafithromycin, which targets azithromycin-resistant community respiratory pathogens; and ODRATE, a once-daily combination of ertapenem and zidebactam for resistant gram-negative infections through outpatient parenteral antimicrobial therapy. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~45% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~8% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 14.0% cost of equity).
PE of 89 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 149), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 89 vs sector median 53; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 56, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
